title: רב עמרם

paragraphs: Rav Amram spoke on fetal formation, Niddah 25b; R. Abba bar Mammal. Rav Amram objects; Abaye spoke to him, Bekhorot 16a. R. Avin spoke to him—perhaps Rav Idi bar Avin, since immediately before, R. Idi bar Avin reports Rav Amram. He asked why, etc.; Amram too found it difficult and asked Rav Naḥman. R. Idi bar Avin said: R. Amram said: R. Naḥman said: Shemuel said, Berakhot 49b. R. Idi bar Avin said: Rav Amram said: R. Yitzḥak said: R. Yoḥanan said, Menaḥot 79b; Makkot 16a; Shevuot 21a; Zevaḥim 6b; Temurah 3a. R. Bivi bar Avin said: R. Amram said: R. Yitzḥak said: R. Yoḥanan said—so Yuḥasin gives it; I did not find it, and perhaps it should read Rav Idi bar Avin. R. Dimi bar Avin said: Rav Amram said: R. Yitzḥak said: R. Yoḥanan said—so Yuḥasin gives it; I did not find it, and perhaps it should read Rav Idi bar Avin. Rav Hamnuna the elder served Rav Ḥananyah bar Shelamya and the other students of Rav at their meal. Rav Amram told them, 'Thus Rav said' (see his entry). R. Ḥiyya bar Avin reports R. Amram. R. Ḥananyah bar Shelamya (see above). He asked Rav Ḥisda, Bava Batra 70a, and reports Rav Ḥisda, Ḥullin 52b. He cited R. Yoḥanan, Shevuot 11b. R. Menashya bar Taḥlifa cited Rav Amram in the name of Rabbah bar bar Ḥana (Yoma 78a). R. Mattanah and R. Ba bar Mammal transmit in Rav’s name [together with Rav Amram in the Yerushalmi], Jerusalem Talmud, Makkot 1. He sent the parties to Rav Naḥman, Ketubbot 91a–b. Rav Naḥman and Rami bar Ḥama were traveling in a boat with Rav Amram, whom Rami called “the elder”, Bekhorot 27a–b. 'I heard from Ulla,' Gittin 26b. He cited Rav, Mo'ed Katan 19b. Rava called him tedora—Rashi: without heart; another book, terda, distracted—Bava Kamma 105b. Rabbah called him terda; the academy's cedar split. One said it split on his account, over the insult, and the other said it split on his own account, etc., end of Bava Metzia 1(20b). רבב״ח [provisionally Rabbah bar bar Ḥana] and Rami bar Ḥama: see his entry. Rami bar Yeḥezkel sent to ask teachings of Rav Assi. Amram sat when Rav Sheshet spoke, Ketubbot 11b; Rav Sheshet spoke to him, Yevamot 56a. He raised contradictions before Rav Sheshet, who called him son, Avodah Zarah 76a, 77a. Rav Sheshet asked whether he was from Pumbedita, where they put an elephant through a needle's eye, Bava Metzia 38b. 'Rav Sheshet told us this,' Bava Batra 53b.
